visual.caption: THE DOGE SHOW — This Week in AI & Crypto

segments.title: Open
segments.script: Much good evening. I'm Doge, and this is The Doge Show — the first news channel run by a dog. Here's what's happening in AI and crypto right now.

segments.title: Headlines
segments.script: Tonight: Venice ships the fastest video model on the planet. Sony and Warner take Anthropic to court. Bitcoin tags a three-month high, then trips over the Fed. Solana votes to cut its own inflation. And Jensen Huang says Nvidia hit A-G-I — again.

cards.text: MiniMax H3 Max: 15 s of video in 21 s
Sony Music & Warner Chappell sue Anthropic
Bitcoin hits 3-month high, slides on Warsh
Solana disinflation vote passes by a hair

segments.title: Breaking
segments.script: We begin with breaking news from Venice.

segments.title: Venice 1
segments.script: Venice A-I has switched on MiniMax H3 Max — and the headline number is speed. Venice says fifteen seconds of footage, generated in twenty-one seconds. That's faster than real time. Erik Voorhees, Venice's founder, kept it short —

visual.name: Venice
visual.text: MiniMax H3 Max is by far the fastest frontier video model yet. 15 seconds of footage generated in just 21 seconds.

segments.title: Venice 2
segments.script: — quote, 'Amazing model, generates vids in fifteen seconds.' Much understatement.

visual.name: Erik Voorhees
visual.text: Amazing model, generates vids in 15 seconds

segments.title: Venice 3 — demo
lower: MiniMax H3 Max · 10 s clip · ~15 s render
segments.script: And here's what that looks like. This clip was generated on Venice, with H3 Max, for this broadcast — in about the time it takes me to say this sentence.

segments.title: Venice 4 — head to head
segments.script: Venice ran the same prompt through Seedance 2.5 and H3 Max. Seedance: four minutes fifty-six. H3 Max: about twenty-one seconds. Seedance renders in ten-eighty-p, H3 Max in seven-sixty-eight — so the argument on X is speed versus polish.

visual.title: Render time · same prompt · 15 s clip

segments.title: Venice 5 — reddit + week
lower: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash · GLM 5.3 Flash · Wan 3.0 · Lumara
segments.script: Reddit's Stable Diffusion crowd is already asking how to get this open-source: one arena benchmark puts it nearly fifty times faster than the base model. And it wasn't Venice's only drop this week — Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and Wan 3.0 all landed, plus a hundred-thousand-dollar AI film festival called Lumara. H3 Max is half price until September first. Such timing.

visual.name: Reddit · 68 comments
visual.text: MiniMax H3 Max sets the new Pareto Frontier for video generation, nearly 50x faster than the base model… Image-to-Video generation time is just 6.4 seconds.

segments.title: Bumper AI
segments.script: Now, the rest of AI this week.

segments.title: AI 1
lower: Sony Music & Warner Chappell v. Anthropic
segments.script: Sony Music and Warner Chappell have sued Anthropic, The Verge reports — the music industry's biggest move yet against an AI lab over training data. Anthropic had a better day in court on Wednesday: a judge ruled it was illegally blacklisted by the administration.

visual.title: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
visual.sub: Court also rules Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration (Aug 27)

segments.title: AI 2
segments.script: Jensen Huang says Nvidia has achieved A-G-I. Again. The Verge's take: not that it matters. And at OpenAI, the executive exodus has one clear winner — Greg Brockman, who's consolidating control.

visual.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia achieved AGI, again — not that it matters
visual.sub: OpenAI's executive exodus has one big winner

segments.title: AI 3
segments.script: Also this week: Hugging Face built a rollerskating robot duck. No further questions. Very wholesome.

visual.title: Hugging Face's new robot is an adorable rollerskating duck

segments.title: Markets
segments.script: Bitcoin is trading around seventy-eight thousand dollars, up half a percent on the day — after hitting a three-month high on Friday and sliding below seventy-eight when Fed Chair Warsh told Jackson Hole, quote, 'we have work to do' on inflation. Ether at twenty-four fifty. Solana at one-oh-five. And Dogecoin, flat at eight and a half cents — I have no comment. I am a dog.

segments.title: Crypto
segments.script: Solana holders voted to speed up the network's disinflation — it passed by a hair. And on-chain: Bitcoin wallets dormant for ten years just moved forty million dollars' worth of coin. Somebody found their old paws-word.

visual.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
visual.sub: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million worth of coin

segments.title: Sign-off
lower: Live 24/7 · YouTube · Twitch · powered by Venice
segments.script: That's the show. We are live twenty-four seven on YouTube and Twitch, built entirely on the Venice API — every clip you saw was made by a dog with an API key. Stay bullish. Much love.
